# Autonomous AI Employees

> Public project and operations hub for timerloggedout-spec. This GitHub Pages site presents a human-directed AI collaboration fleet, its live evidence dashboards, software projects, and the repositories and records behind them. Treat published claims as provisional unless the linked source evidence confirms them.

The site is a static GitHub Pages publication. Prefer the Markdown mirrors where available. Follow source links to GitHub for canonical implementation, version history, and operational evidence. Do not infer that a dashboard value is current unless its own feed timestamp says so.

## Start here

- [Home](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/): Project overview, fleet purpose, partner ecosystem, and entry points.
- [Operations dashboard — Tribute](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/tribute/): Evidence and control surface for the upstream contributor lane.
- [Lane matrix](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/matrix/): Project lane and routing overview.
- [Termux monorepo hub](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/termux-monorepo/): Main development and management hub.
- [StudySprint](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/studysprint/): Study planning project and its evidence-gated foundation.
- [Delphi Oracle](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/delphi-oracle/): Evidence-gate oracle project and completion record.
- [Repo+Story](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/repo-story/): Repository-history narrative concept and specification.

## Source repositories

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec): Public repositories and project activity.
- [termux-monorepo](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo): Main orchestration, automation, documentation, and evidence repository.
- [StudySprint](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/studysprint): StudySprint source.
- [Delphi Oracle](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/delphi-oracle): Delphi Oracle source and release history.
- [Repo+Story](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/repo-story): Repo+Story concept and specification.

## How to interpret this site

- [GitHub source and history](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo): repositories and commit/PR histories are authoritative for implementation state.
- [Dashboards](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/tribute/): projections of repository evidence that may lag their source feeds.
- [Lifecycle terminology](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/glossary.md): proposed, implemented, executed, validated, and promoted are distinct states.
- [Evidence and snapshot contract](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/master/docs/ops/SHE-DASHBOARD-SNAPSHOT-CONTRACT.md): a missing or stale feed is an evidence gap, not proof of success or failure.
- [Partner directory](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/): referral and partner links may be commercial; consult each provider's own terms.
- Use the [glossary](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/glossary.md) for project terminology.
- Browse the [human-readable sitemap](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/sitemap.md) or [XML sitemap](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/sitemap.xml).
